_why: 육아 트랙 행위 클립 요청. 🚨 아기가 프레임에 보이는 요청은 전부 kind=still — Flow(Veo) 미성년자 안전필터를 안 타려고 미드저니 스틸 한 장만 받고 푸시인·점등은 scripts/make_part_clip.py가 입힌다. 사물과 성인 손만 나오는 비접촉 동작만 Flow로 보낸다.

requests.why: `--for 분유`·`수유`로 나오는 건 part_breast_ducts(유방 단면)뿐이라 행위 칸에 못 쓴다. 용기를 다루는 행위 클립 중 가장 가까운 act_drink_caffeine은 컵을 들어 고개를 젖히며 본인이 마시고 마지막에 뇌까지 켜지는 컷이고(색인 주의문: 단순 수분 섭취로 쓰면 과하다), act_shaky_hands는 물컵을 쥔 손이 떨리는 컷이다. 둘 다 '재서 넣고 섞는' 동작이 아예 없다. 이 편의 훅이 '분유를 진하게 타는 분이 많은데'라 계량스푼을 평평하게 깎는 그 한 동작이 왼쪽 칸의 전부다.

requests.flow: One continuous shot in a single unbroken scene with no scene cuts. Only two translucent glass hands, a blank tin, a small scoop and a tall clear feeding bottle are ever in frame — no face, no head, no body, and nothing else enters the frame. 0-1.5s: from the very first frame the right hand pulls the scoop up out of the tin heaped and overflowing, powder spilling off its sides, and the camera drops low and pushes in level with the tin's rim. 1.5-3s: the scoop is dragged sideways across the straight edge of the tin's rim in one slow even pass and the heap is shaved flat and dead level, the shaved powder falling back into the tin, and the hand holds the levelled scoop still for a beat so the flat top reads clearly. 3-4.5s: the levelled scoop tips into the bottle's neck and the powder falls through into the water, then the other hand screws the collar and teat down with one short quarter-turn. 4.5-6s: both palms close around the bottle and roll it back and forth between them so it spins about its own long axis, the bottle staying upright and never lifted, never jerked up and down and never shaken, the liquid turning an even soft amber with a flat clear surface and no foam and no bubble layer forming on top, held that way until the very last frame, the dark slate blue-grey void staying empty. The hands stay translucent glass with the finger bones visible inside throughout. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no arrows anywhere in the frame; nothing in the frame carries printed markings of any kind. The audio is a low synth drone with a dry scrape as the scoop is levelled and a soft rolling rustle at the end, no music, no dialogue.

requests.name: act_baby_belly_massage
